title: rs.ge e-invoice: test checklist
intro: {n_cases} test cases: how Odoo sends invoices to rs.ge (the Georgian tax website), receives supplier invoices, and refuses dangerous actions. You don't need to know Odoo: each row says what to click, where to look and what you must see.
admin_fill: (password: ask the admin, never write it here)
test_data: Accounting › Customers › Customers › [New]: name TEST Buyer, Tax ID = TIN of the BUYER test user.
Same, name TEST Supplier, Tax ID = TIN of the SUPPLIER test user. (One test user for both? Use TEST Buyer for both.)
Accounting › Customers › Products › [New]: name TEST Service, Product Type = Service, Sales Price = 100. Sales Taxes shows 18%.
starting_points: Accounting › Customers › Invoices › [New] › Customer TEST Buyer › tab Invoice Lines › Add a line › TEST Service, quantity 1 › [Confirm]. Total 118.00.
A, then tab RS E-Invoice › [Send to RS].
B, then [Send to buyer]. Current Status: Sent (Pending).
C, then the buyer confirms it on rs.ge, then [Status Update]. Current Status: Confirmed.
On rs.ge as the SUPPLIER: create an invoice to your company (TIN 206322102), 1 line, total 118 incl. VAT 18, send it, copy its ID.
tips: Starting point D is needed 10 times. Make 10 at once: open one invoice › gear icon › Duplicate › [Confirm] › [Send to RS] › [Send to buyer]; confirm them all on rs.ge; then [Status Update] on each.
never: Never use real customers or suppliers. rs.ge is live: every invoice sent is real.
Check Vendor and ID before [Pull from rs.ge]. If the pull fails, that bill can't be fixed or deleted (known bug) — tell the admin.
where: Buttons at the top
Top of the invoice, on the left, just under the invoice number.
[Confirm] [Reset to Draft] [Credit Note] [Pay] [View RS Data]
Top right (status)
Top of the invoice, on the right, same line as those buttons.
The words Draft › Posted; the current one is highlighted. Cancelled when cancelled.
Tab RS E-Invoice
In the middle of the invoice, next to the tabs Invoice Lines and Other Info.
Click it. Everything about rs.ge is inside this tab.
Current Status
Inside tab RS E-Invoice: the big box near the top.
Left: RS Invoice ID (a number). Right: Current Status (Draft, Sent (Pending), Confirmed …).
Buttons inside the tab
Inside tab RS E-Invoice, right under Current Status.
[Send to RS] [Update on RS] [Send to buyer] [Delete on RS] [Cancel on RS] [Status Update]. Bills: [Pull from rs.ge] [Accept on rs.ge] [Reject on rs.ge].
Coloured box (top of the tab)
Inside tab RS E-Invoice, at the very top.
A yellow, red or grey box with a message.
Fields on tab RS E-Invoice
Inside tab RS E-Invoice, under the Seller and Buyer boxes.
RS Note (text) · Advance Invoice (switch) · Advance Settlement (only on invoices with a down payment)
Goods / Services › column RS
Inside tab RS E-Invoice: the table under the title Goods / Services. Column RS is right after the line number.
Not Sent · Synced · Pending Edit (red) · Confirmed
Goods / Services › column Tax
Same table, a few columns to the right.
taxable · VAT 0% · without VAT
rs.ge Source Lines
Vendor bills only: inside tab RS E-Invoice, the table under Goods / Services.
The lines exactly as the supplier filed them on rs.ge.
RS Logs
Inside tab RS E-Invoice, the last table at the bottom.
Every message Odoo exchanged with rs.ge.
Tab Invoice Lines
The first tab in the middle of the invoice.
The products: quantity, price, taxes.
Total (tab Invoice Lines)
Tab Invoice Lines, bottom right.
Total 118.00
Pop-up window
Opens in the middle of the screen.
An error or a question. Read it, then close it.
Small message (top right)
Top right corner of the screen; goes away by itself.
For example: Credentials valid.
Corner ribbon
A diagonal band in the top right corner of the invoice page.
Skip rs.ge · In Payment · Paid · Reversed
Small boxes (top right of the page)
Top right of the invoice page, above the fields.
Credit Notes · Replaced By · Replaces — click one to open that document.
Gear icon · cloud icon · X icon
Next to the invoice number at the very top.
Gear: Duplicate, Delete. Cloud: save. X: discard your changes.
Grid icon
Top left corner of the screen.
Opens the list of apps: Accounting, Sales, Settings …

parts.title: PART 1 — SALES: you send invoices to a buyer (rs.ge window: log in as the BUYER test user)

cases.title: Check the connection to rs.ge
cases.goal: Odoo can log in to rs.ge with your company's rs.ge user.
steps: Grid icon › *Settings* › *Users & Companies* › *Users* › click your name

cases.title: Send an invoice; the buyer confirms it
cases.goal: The normal day: Odoo files the invoice on rs.ge, the buyer confirms it there.
steps: Find the invoice with this RS Invoice ID and confirm it.
Buttons at the top › [View RS Data]

cases.title: Change the lines while the invoice is a Draft on rs.ge
cases.goal: A change made in Odoo reaches rs.ge before the buyer sees the invoice.
steps: Buttons at the top › [Reset to Draft] › tab *Invoice Lines* › Quantity = *2* › [Confirm]
Red *Pending Edit* (Odoo changed, rs.ge not yet)
Buttons at the top › [View RS Data]

cases.title: Remove the invoice from rs.ge before sending
cases.goal: A mistake can be removed from rs.ge while the buyer hasn't seen it.
steps: RS Invoice ID and Current Status are *gone*; [Send to RS] is back

cases.title: Change the lines after sending, before the buyer answers
cases.goal: Until the buyer answers, Odoo sends your change to rs.ge by itself.
steps: Buttons at the top › [Reset to Draft] › tab *Invoice Lines* › Quantity = *3* › [Confirm]

cases.title: The buyer rejects; you fix it and send again
cases.goal: A rejected invoice is fixed and sent again on the same rs.ge record.
steps: [Reset to Draft] › Quantity = *2* › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Update on RS] › [Send to buyer]
*Sent (Pending)* · red box gone · same RS Invoice ID

cases.title: Cancel a confirmed invoice; the buyer agrees
cases.goal: Odoo cancels the invoice only after the buyer agrees on rs.ge.

cases.title: Cancel a confirmed invoice; the buyer refuses
cases.goal: If the buyer refuses, the invoice stays as it was.

cases.title: Cancel a paid invoice
cases.goal: Odoo never undoes a payment by itself: it stops and tells you.
steps: Coloured box (top of the tab) + Top right (status)
Red: *…Odoo could not cancel it.* · still *Posted*

cases.title: Cancel an invoice from last month
cases.start: D, but set Invoice Date = a day of last month before [Confirm]
cases.goal: A month already declared is not changed: Odoo adds a credit note dated today instead.
steps: Small boxes (top right of the page) + Corner ribbon
Box *Credit Notes* appears · ribbon *Reversed* · top right still *Posted*

cases.title: Correct the price of a confirmed invoice; the buyer accepts
cases.goal: A corrected copy replaces the old invoice on rs.ge; Odoo then cancels the old one.
steps: RS Treatment = *Replace RS invoice with a corrected invoice* (already chosen)
Reason for RS correction = *Change price or amount* › [Reverse and Create Invoice]
New invoice: tab *Invoice Lines* › Price = *80* › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS]

cases.title: Correct the price; the buyer rejects the correction
cases.goal: A rejected correction comes back to you to fix; the old invoice stays as it was.
steps: Tab *Invoice Lines* › Price = *90* › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to buyer]

cases.title: Cancel an invoice and make a new one
cases.goal: For a wrong buyer: rs.ge cancels the old invoice first, then a new invoice goes out.
steps: Buttons at the top › [Credit Note] › RS Treatment = *Cancel old RS invoice and issue a new one* › [Reverse and Create Invoice]
*Cannot post or send this replacement invoice yet…* (right: it waits for the buyer)
Confirm the cancellation of the OLD invoice.
Small box *Replaces* (opens the old invoice) › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Status Update]
Small box *Replaced By* (opens the new invoice) › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS] › [Send to buyer]
*Sent (Pending)* with its own new RS Invoice ID

cases.title: Credit note only in Odoo
cases.goal: Some credit notes (for example a netting) must never go to rs.ge.
steps: Buttons at the top › [Credit Note] › RS Treatment = *Only correct Odoo, not rs.ge* › Skip Reason = *Netting / offset (no VAT event)* › [Reverse]
*None* — it can't be sent to rs.ge

cases.title: Invoice with a note for rs.ge
cases.goal: Text written in "RS Note" appears on the rs.ge invoice.
steps: Tab *RS E-Invoice* › RS Note = *TEST NOTE* › [Confirm] › [Send to RS] › [Send to buyer]
The note *TEST NOTE* is on it

cases.title: Lines with 18%, 0% and no VAT
cases.start: A new invoice for TEST Buyer
cases.goal: rs.ge gets the right VAT for each line.
steps: Tab *Invoice Lines*: 3 lines of TEST Service — line 1 tax *18%*, line 2 tax *0% EXT G*, line 3 no tax (remove it) › [Confirm]
Tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS] › buttons at the top › [View RS Data]

cases.title: Invoice in US dollars
cases.start: A new standard invoice; a USD rate exists (Accounting › Configuration › Accounting › Currencies)
cases.goal: rs.ge always receives amounts in GEL.
steps: Currency = *USD* › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS] › [View RS Data]

cases.title: 30-day deadline warning
cases.start: A new standard invoice (don't send it)
cases.goal: Odoo warns before the legal 30-day deadline for the invoice passes.
steps: Invoice Date = *today minus 26 days* › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice*
Another one with Invoice Date = *today minus 31 days*

cases.title: Down payment (advance) invoice
cases.start: A confirmed sales order: Grid icon › Sales › [New] › Customer TEST Buyer › product TEST Service, quantity 10 › [Confirm]
cases.goal: A down payment goes to rs.ge as an advance invoice.
steps: *Advance Invoice* is switched on by itself
[Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS] › [Send to buyer]

cases.title: Final invoice after the down payment
cases.goal: The final invoice subtracts the down payment on rs.ge.
steps: Sales › Orders › Orders › the same order › [Create Invoice] › *Regular invoice* › [Create Draft]
[Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS] › [View RS Data]
Total = order total *minus* the down payment · no minus line

parts.title: PART 2 — PURCHASES: suppliers send invoices to you (rs.ge window: log in as the SUPPLIER test user)

cases.title: Bring a supplier invoice into Odoo
cases.goal: The supplier's rs.ge invoice becomes a vendor bill with the same lines.
steps: Accounting › *Vendors* › *Bills* › [New] › Vendor = TEST Supplier › tab *RS E-Invoice* › paste the ID into *RS Invoice ID (from supplier)*
The ID is in the box
Check Vendor and ID once more › [Pull from rs.ge]
Look at the buttons at the top

cases.title: Accept the supplier invoice
cases.goal: You approve on rs.ge and Odoo books the bill.
steps: Tab *RS E-Invoice* › section *rs.ge Source Lines (from supplier)*
Same amounts as the bill lines

cases.title: Reject a supplier invoice
cases.start: E, then test case 21 steps 1-2 with the new ID
cases.goal: You refuse a wrong invoice; the supplier sees your reason.
steps: Tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Reject on rs.ge] › Rejection Reason = *Test* › [Reject on rs.ge] › [Ok]
Coloured box (top of the tab) + Top right (status)

cases.title: rs.ge Inbox: bring several at once
cases.start: The supplier sent you 2 new invoices
cases.goal: Many supplier invoices come in with one click.
steps: *2* draft bills, each with its line

cases.title: Undo your edits on a supplier bill
cases.start: A draft bill from test case 24
cases.goal: [Reimport Lines] puts the rs.ge values back.

cases.title: The supplier corrects an invoice you accepted
cases.start: The accepted bill from test case 22 (not paid)
cases.goal: Odoo replaces your bill with the supplier's corrected one.
steps: Correct that invoice to total *94.40* incl. VAT *14.40* and send the correction.
Yellow: *Supplier issued a correction on rs.ge…*
A *new draft bill* opens, Total *94.40* (old bill: Cancelled)

cases.title: The supplier cancels an invoice you accepted
cases.start: A bill you accepted (accept one from test case 24 first)
cases.goal: Odoo cancels your bill only after you agree on rs.ge.

parts.title: PART 3 — SAFETY: Odoo must refuse; an error message = Pass (rs.ge window: back to the BUYER test user)

cases.title: Send an invoice to a customer without Tax ID
cases.goal: Odoo refuses to send an invoice without the buyer's TIN.
steps: New invoice › Customer: type *TEST NoTIN* › Create › line TEST Service › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS]
*Partner 'TEST NoTIN' has no TIN…* — nothing sent

cases.title: Change the customer after rs.ge has the invoice
cases.goal: The customer is locked once rs.ge has the invoice.
steps: [Reset to Draft] › Customer = TEST Supplier › cloud icon (save)

cases.title: Reset a confirmed invoice to draft
cases.goal: A confirmed invoice can't be edited in Odoo.
steps: Buttons at the top › [Reset to Draft]
*Cannot reset to draft — it is live on rs.ge…*

cases.title: Delete an invoice that rs.ge still has
cases.goal: Odoo can't delete an invoice that is on rs.ge.

cases.title: Correct an invoice before the buyer confirms it
cases.goal: No correction until the buyer has confirmed.
steps: [Credit Note] › Replace RS invoice with a corrected invoice › any reason › [Reverse and Create Invoice]
*…can only start from a confirmed rs.ge invoice…*

cases.title: Bad-debt credit note that keeps VAT
cases.goal: A bad debt can't reduce VAT.
steps: [Credit Note] › Only correct Odoo, not rs.ge › Skip Reason = *Bad debt write-off…* › [Reverse] › [Confirm]
The draft credit note is deleted

cases.title: Send a credit note to rs.ge on its own
cases.goal: Credit notes never go to rs.ge by themselves.
steps: Accounting › *Customers* › *Credit Notes* › [New] › Customer TEST Buyer › line TEST Service › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Send to RS]
*This credit note is not linked to an original invoice…*

cases.title: Edit after the buyer confirmed in the meantime
cases.goal: Odoo won't book lines that rs.ge doesn't have.
steps: *…the buyer confirmed it on rs.ge in the meantime…*
Quantity back to *1* › [Confirm] › tab *RS E-Invoice* › [Status Update]

cases.title: The same rs.ge invoice on two bills
cases.goal: One rs.ge invoice can't be booked twice.
steps: Accounting › *Vendors* › *Bills* › [New] › Vendor TEST Supplier › paste the same ID as test case 21 › cloud icon (save)
*The same rs.ge Invoice ID cannot be linked to two Odoo documents…*
